data.title: BTC Digital Stock Soars Over 111% After-Hours, BitMine Shares Trending as Bitcoin and Ethereum Regain Their Mojo
data.description: BTC Digital Ltd. (NASDAQ:BTCT) and BitMine Immersion Technologies Inc. (NYSE:BMNR) shares are trending on Thursday.BTCT gained 111.55% to $1.77 after the bell on Wednesday.
